errors.text: The cited NbMoTaWVTi study does not demonstrate a dual-BCC bulk product after SPS: it reports two BCC solutions only in milled powder, followed by formation of an FCC TiO precipitate during consolidation.
The cited mechanical properties include precipitation strengthening from TiO, so they cannot substantiate the proposed intermetallic-free, dual-solid-solution strengthening mechanism.
The supplied evidence does not establish a final grain size below 50 nm.

The proposed falsification experiment does not distinguish grain-boundary strengthening from simple solid-solution strengthening because SPS temperature simultaneously changes grain size, phase constitution, contamination, and densification.
